meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 给项目加上 Google Chat 渠道:从 channels 分支拷入适配器、注册并安装依赖、构建并跑注册测试。Google Cloud 凭据需要你手动配置,配好前它收不到消息。
howto.when: 当你想让 NanoClaw 接收 Google Chat 消息(团队 space 或私聊),或正跟着 /setup 流程走时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Google Chat 渠道
say.note: 会拷入适配器、注册、装依赖、构建并跑测试

howto.what_en: Adds Google Chat support: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, builds, and runs one registration test. Google Cloud credentials are set up by hand; until then it can't receive messages.
howto.when_en: Use when you want NanoClaw to accept Google Chat (team spaces or direct messages), or while following the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel for me.
Run /manage-channels to wire gchat to an agent group.
say_en.note: Binds the channel to that agent group.

say_en.text: Check that GCHAT_CREDENTIALS in .env is the whole JSON on one line.
